newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Carso resumed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Carso resumed.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Urban Larson said he had resumed coverage of Mexican holding company Grupo Carso SA de CV with a hold recommendation.
-- "At a 21 percent premium to net asset value and a 1997 P/E of 14.7, the shares of Grupo Carso are fairly valued in our opinion," he wrote in an analysis.

-- "The spinoff of Carso's telecommunications holdings and various portfolio investments underlines the conglomerate's greater emphasis on the consolidation and re-evaluation of its existing businesses, rather than growth through acquisitions."
-- The company's shares were up 0.05 pesos to 49.15 in Mexico City.
